event_only.caption: Table S14 Test-period skill on all monitored cell-days and on rainfall-event cell-days only
event_only.footnote: Event cell-days (D ≥ 1, G = 2) are 42.6 % of the 487,974 test cell-days and contain 351 of the 377 landslide days; the other 26 fell on non-event days and can never be alerted by an event-based threshold. TSS at each method's calibrated operating point; frequentist score = ln E − β ln D. The MaCumBA-type threshold uses a different event definition (G = 1) and is omitted.

sact_coefficients.caption: Table S13 Logistic coefficients of the base SACT model and exponents of the closed-form threshold (Eq. 8)
sact_coefficients.footnote: Fitted on 309,922 calibration event days (2007-2012), L2-penalised logistic regression (C = 10). Intervals from a cell-block bootstrap. Threshold parameters: ln α = (logit p* − b_0)/b_E with p* = 0.00066; exponents are −b/b_E. Intervals of the exponents are wide because b_E is small; the S exponent is unstable because its coefficient spans zero.
